title: Current baseline, where the code is, who did what
summary: The ooDialog Designer writes ooDialog programs in ooRexx from a drag-and-drop form, in the manner of VisPro/REXX, VX-REXX and DrDialog. Architecture: Tom Dyer. Code: Claude (Opus 5.5); the Database Lab: ChatGPT. It runs in a browser on ooDialog/WASM and Josep Maria Blasco's ooRexx/WASM 0.2.4; the programs it writes are plain upstream ooDialog for Windows. Published: packages/oorexx_oodialog_designer_v0.7, v0.8 (plugins) and v0.9 (bound dialogs) in animatedads/alchemy; working branch oodialog-designer in animatedads/oorexx (folder oodialog-designer/, mirror of the Object Editor in object-editor/). In progress 2026-11-15: v0.10, the reference picker (combo box bound to a one-part) and Add/Remove of a bound list's parts with row detail fields.
invariants: Check packages/ on a fresh pull of alchemy main before choosing a version number: a version that exists is never reused.
Every class has module_version and module_lastChanged.
Every update names the architect (Tom Dyer), the coder (Claude (Opus 5.5) or ChatGPT) and the model writing it.
Do not work in Autobuild's checkout; submit with tools/alchemy_submit.py.
The Database Lab is ChatGPT's lane (oorexx_oodialog_database_lab); the designer, plugins and bound dialogs are Claude's. Changes across lanes go by Falcon request.
